item.title: Visa helps small businesses gear up for FIFA World Cup '26
item.description: Visa has created a new program called Visa & Main to help small businesses prepare for the FIFA World Cup '26 by providing access to capital, reaching new customers, and providing access to modern business tools.

item.title: $3 million Honus Wagner card on display in Dallas ahead of auction
item.description: A Honus Wagner baseball card valued at over $3 million is on display in Dallas ahead of the Heritage Auctions Winter Platinum Sports Auction, featuring historic jerseys and Olympic memorabilia.

item.title: Texas cities dominate top 10 for fatal rush hour crashes
item.description: Texas cities dominate top 10 for fatal rush hour crashes, according to a new study.

item.title: Rising romance author marks debut novel with local event
item.description: Haley-Grace McCormick will celebrate the debut of her adult romance novel, "The Enemy of Time," with an event in Denton featuring an author chat, junk journaling craft session, and book signing.

item.title: Velvet Taco & On the Border offer discounted margaritas
item.description: Velvet Taco and On The Border are offering discounted margarita specials to celebrate the start of patio season.

item.title: Charmed Soles unveils Asian-inspired grip socks for yoga and Pilates
item.description: Charmed Soles has launched a line of high-performance grip socks for Pilates, barre, and yoga, featuring heart-shaped grips and designs inspired by Asian culture, with prices starting at $25.

item.title: Einstein Bros. Bagels introduces limited-time hot honey shmear
item.description: Einstein Bros. Bagels has launched its new Hot Honey Shmear as a limited-time offering, featuring a sweet and spicy flavor profile, available in two limited-time sandwiches and as an add-on to any bagel on the menu.

item.title: Mendocino Farms unveils new savory menu options for 2026
item.description: Mendocino Farms will launch its first seasonal menu update of 2026, featuring three dishes crafted by Executive Chef Jeremy Bringardner, including a Smoky BBQ Brioche Sandwich, Farmhouse Ranch Salad, and Seasonal GOAT with Sweet Citrus, on February 24, 2026.

item.title: Taco Bell drops new chicken bacon ranch items for a limited time
item.description: Taco Bell has launched the Chicken Bacon Ranch Street Chalupas and Chicken Bacon Ranch Nacho Fries, featuring slow-roasted chicken, crispy bacon and avocado ranch sauce, with promotional offers available through the Taco Bell mobile app.

item.title: Cloudy skies in D-FW, overnight clearing expected
item.description: Dallas-Fort Worth will experience cloudy conditions throughout the day with temperatures in the mid to upper 60s, clearing out overnight.
